title: Query Feedback and Teaching for Stable and Certifiable Language Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.28918v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language generation in the limit studies whether a learner observing an enumeration of an unknown target language can eventually generate only valid, previously unseen elements. We study stability, introduced by Kalavasis, Mehrotra, and Velegkas (2025), which requires the generator's infinite output set to eventually remain unchanged, and introduce the stronger notion of certifiability, which requires the generator to determine from its observations that its current output is valid. Drawing on teaching sets in learning theory, we introduce a hierarchy of teaching dimensions for generation under three increasingly strict success criteria: correctness, stability, and certifiability. These dimensions measure the minimum number of selected examples whose appearance guarantees the corresponding success condition. translated_title: 面向稳定与可认证语言生成的查询反馈与教学
translated_abstract: 极限意义下的语言生成研究的是：一个观察未知目标语言枚举序列的学习者，是否最终能够只生成有效的、之前未见过的元素。我们研究了由 Kalavasis、Mehrotra 和 Velegkas（2025）提出的稳定性概念，它要求生成器的无限输出集合最终保持不变，并引入了更强的可认证性概念，即要求生成器能够根据其观测判断出当前输出是有效的。借鉴学习理论中的教学集思想，我们在三种越来越严格的成功标准下——正确性、稳定性和可认证性——为生成任务引入了教学维度的层级结构。这些维度衡量了使相应成功条件得到保证所需的所选示例的最少数量。我们还在 Charikar 和 Pabbaraju（2025）的成员查询模型中研究了稳定性与可认证性。我们对稳定（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 本文在极限语言生成中引入了更强的“可认证性”概念，并借鉴教学集理论建立了正确性、稳定性与可认证性三级教学维度层级，同时进一步研究了成员查询模型下的稳定性与可认证性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the stronger notion of certifiability for language generation in the limit, establishes a hierarchy of teaching dimensions across the success criteria of correctness, stability, and certifiability, and further studies these properties in the membership-query model.
